output: SELECT m.name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN maint.maint_id IS NOT NULL THEN b.bike_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.bike_id), 1) AS maintenance_percentage FROM model m LEFT JOIN bike b ON m.model_id = b.model_id LEFT JOIN maintenance maint ON b.bike_id = maint.bike_id GROUP BY m.model_id, m.name;
